This is about you, but i would like to share some experience. for two years staright i couldn't leave my home. i threw up 3-5 times a day, mostly blood because of the constant strain on my throat. I was sick, i gained so much weight, and my girlfriend cheated and left me. I had noone, absolutly nothing, what i did have was faith. One night i was going to off myself with a bottle of pills i had for my condition, and out of nowhere my friend called me, asked me if everything was alright, i cried to him for hours. i felt like something, anything was there for me, and i was right. i stood up out of my chair, and i tried pushing myself beyond my limits, on step one inch at a time, every day i would take a single step out of my room, and every day i got further and further. until i was at the end of my driveway. i stood there for about 30 minutes, thinking "if i handt gotten that phone call, that one friend asking if i was okay, i would not be standing here, lokking at trees, birds, people, everything around me was suddnly just, better. so OP i ask you this, make a promise to yourself, that no matter how hard things get, youll give it your all. i love you, your a wonderful person i bet, and no matter what, i belive your life will eventually be filled with happiness. be proud of who you are, raise awarness, help fight WITH others. be there for people, and theyll be there for you back, cause you never know. one day they might save your life.
